column1: # Intended changes of asserted facts (append-only). The owner reviews the new lines of each pull request.
# Use it when real BC does something else than a test asserted and the test is corrected: the old fact is then gone, and
# .github/scripts/facts.py diff would report it as lost. One line per changed fact, ten tab-separated columns:
#   key (<app folder>/<codeunit id>/<test name> or mnc/<case stem>), the old fact (kind, value, members, ifctx),
#   the new fact (kind, value, members, ifctx) and the reason. The reason is required.
# The "LOST FACT" report of facts.py diff prints the first five columns of the line to add.
# Never edit or remove a line.

column3: old_value
column7: new_value
column10: reason
